controllers.primary: exact finite expectation of actual frozen backbone

diagnostics.benchmark_input: already loaded raw IID test input; no model selection

secondary_comparison.matrix: same tasks, widths, seeds, updates, batch, optimizer; separate source freeze before training and test
secondary_comparison.parameters: architecture counts differ; report actual counts and quality-cost curves
secondary_comparison.scope: small NumPy CPU references; no GPU or neuromorphic efficiency claim

inference.paired_unit: model seed within task and width

decision_rules.mathematics: all preregistered deterministic tolerances and Monte Carlo consistency checks reported
decision_rules.raw_memory: heldout full-history quality plus paired last-observation ablation; preserve failures
decision_rules.controller: compare each frozen backbone with dev-selected lightweight and learned value policy
decision_rules.boundary: predicted task advantage versus exact conditional successor values and independent actual execution
decision_rules.scale: describe observed three-width frontiers only; this is not a foundation-model scaling law
